name: frevio-extension
description: Automatic coding activity & real-time presence sync for freelancers and clients on Frevio.

commands.title: Frevio: AI Draft Update from Git Commits
Frevio: Wrap Up Session & Send Update
Frevio: Upload Build / Release for Client
Frevio: Log Manual / Browser Testing Time

frevio.showBillableInStatusBar.description: Show today's tracked hours and billable amount in the status bar.

frevio.enableEditorNotifications.description: Show real-time notifications in VS Code when clients approve deliverables or comment.

frevio.apiBaseUrl.description: Base URL for the Frevio web application (e.g. http://localhost:3000 for local development).

frevio.heartbeatIntervalSeconds.description: Interval in seconds between heartbeats sent to Frevio when actively coding.

frevio.idleTimeoutMinutes.description: Minutes of inactivity before pausing tracking and marking status as idle.

frevio.promptOnSessionWrapUp.description: Prompt to send a client progress update when pausing tracking or wrapping up a session.

frevio.browserTestingGracePeriodMinutes.description: Minutes to continue tracking time when switching to Chrome or external browser (e.g. testing localhost, inspecting DevTools). Set to 0 to disable.

frevio.promptAwayCatchUp.description: Prompt to log untracked browser testing time when returning to VS Code after an extended away period.
